# watchpoint_domain_verification (Data Source)

Looks up a single DNS domain verification by domain within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_domain_verification" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain to look up (case-insensitive), e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Domain verification ID.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain has been verified.
